{'text': 'Walmart has officially announced that, after holding out for over a decade, it will finally begin rolling out Apple Pay.', 'is_translation': '沃爾瑪正式宣布，在堅持超過十年後，終於將開始推出 Apple Pay。'}

{'text': 'When will Apple Pay be available at your local Walmart? I have the full rollout schedule, including everything you need to know...', 'is_translation': '幾時 Apple Pay 會喺你嗰間沃爾瑪可以使用？我攞到完整嘅推出計劃，內容包括晒所有相關資訊……'}

{'text': 'Walmart Apple Pay rollout schedule', 'is_translation': '沃爾瑪 Apple Pay 推出時間表'}

{'text': "In today's announcement, Walmart said Apple Pay and broader contactless payment support will begin rolling out starting next week, with completion across all U.S. stores expected by the end of this year.", 'is_translation': '喺今日嘅公告中，沃爾瑪表示 Apple Pay 以及更廣泛嘅非接觸式支付支援將會由下星期起陸續推出，並預計喺今年年底前覆蓋全美所有門市。'}

{'text': "According to an internal memo sent today to Walmart store managers and obtained by 9to5Mac, the retailer provided more detailed rollout specifics. The company is currently planning a phased, state-by-state approach. If any issues arise during the rollout, dates may shift. Here's the current roadmap:", 'is_translation': '根據 9to5Mac 取得嘅一份今日發給沃爾瑪各分店管理層嘅內部備忘錄，呢間零售商提供咗更詳細嘅推出細節。公司目前正計劃以分階段、按州分區嘅方式進行。如果喺推行過程中遇到任何問題，相關日期可能會有所調整，以下係目前嘅路線圖：'}

States Tap to Pay Launch Arkansas Aug. 24–31 California, Washington, Oregon, Nevada, Idaho, Alaska, Hawaii Sept. 10 Kansas, Louisiana, Nebraska, Oklahoma Sept. 14 Texas Sept. 17 Arizona, Utah, Colorado, New Mexico, South Dakota, Montana, North Dakota, Wyoming Sept. 21 Illinois, Ohio, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Iowa Sept. 24 Tennessee, Indiana, Michigan, Kentucky Sept. 28 Georgia, Alabama, Mississippi Oct. 1 Florida Oct. 5 North Carolina, Virginia, South Carolina, West Virginia, Puerto Rico Oct. 8 Pennsylvania, New York, New Jersey, Massachusetts, Maryland, Connecticut, New Hampshire, Maine, Delaware, Rhode Island, Vermont, District of Columbia Oct. 12

{'text': "Missouri does not appear to currently be on the schedule, and it's not immediately clear why.", 'is_translation': '目前嘅時間表上似乎未見到密蘇里州（Missouri），暫時唔清楚當中原因。'}

{'text': 'Walmart also listed all of the contactless payment methods that will be supported in the memo:', 'is_translation': '喺備忘錄中，沃爾瑪亦同時列出咗所有將會支援嘅非接觸式支付方式：'}

  • {'text': 'Contactless-enabled credit and debit cards', 'is_translation': '支援非接觸式功能嘅信用卡及扣帳卡'}
  • {'text': 'Digital wallets, including Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay', 'is_translation': '數碼錢包，包括 Apple Pay、Google Pay 及 Samsung Pay'}
  • {'text': 'Smartwatches and wearables with payment support', 'is_translation': '支援以支付功能嘅智能手錶及穿戴式裝置'}
  • {'text': 'Contactless-capable EBT cards', 'is_translation': '支援嘅非接觸式 EBT 卡'}

{'text': "It's been a long time coming for Walmart to support Apple Pay. Will it change where you choose to shop? Let us know in the comments.", 'is_translation': '沃爾瑪支援 Apple Pay 已經等咗好耐。佢會唔會改變你揀邊度購物嘅決定？歡迎喺留言區告訴我哋。'}

{'text': "Chance's top picks:", 'is_translation': 'Chance 嘅心水推介：'}

  • {'text': 'AirPods Pro 3: $189 (originally $249)', 'is_translation': 'AirPods Pro 3：189 美元（原價 249 美元）'}
  • {'text': 'Bring wireless CarPlay to any car', 'is_translation': '將無線 CarPlay 帶到任何汽車'}
  • {'text': 'Apple: The First 50 Years by David Pogue', 'is_translation': '《Apple: The First 50 Years》，作者 David Pogue'}
  • {'text': 'Logitech MX Master 4', 'is_translation': 'Logitech MX Master 4'}
  • {'text': 'Belkin 3-in-1 MagSafe charger', 'is_translation': 'Belkin 3 合 1 MagSafe 充電器'}
  • {'text': 'Beats woven USB-C cable', 'is_translation': 'Beats 織布 USB-C 充電線'}

{'text': 'Follow Chance: Threads, Bluesky, Instagram, and Mastodon.', 'is_translation': '追蹤 Chance：Threads、Bluesky、Instagram 及 Mastodon。'}
